value.text: The captured OpenAPI declaration lists GET /, GET /api/weather, GET /health, GET /openapi.json, POST /api/places, and POST /api/places/{id}/refresh. It marks the place-save JSON body as required and declares response sets for the save and refresh routes; the source handler forwards the Places response status and JSON body, or maps a caught failure to 503. The refresh handler encodes the id in a bodyless POST. The weather handler selects saved cards ordered by name; the health handler runs SELECT 1 and rejects a false consumerReady flag. Startup source subscribes to weather.place-requested and weather.forecast-updated with fromBeginning true and passes eachMessage to consumeMessage with autoCommit false. The route and topic declarations are source evidence only.
